summary: Flikweert Vision develops and builds optical sorting machines for potatoes and onions, using industrial cameras and AI to grade by colour, shape and defects and to remove stones and clods. It is a family business based in Nieuwerkerk, Zeeland, Netherlands, active since 2019.
machines: QualityGrader: optical grader sorting on colour, shape and defects, up to 30 tonnes per hour
Divider: optical pre-sorter removing stones, clods and foreign objects, up to 120 tonnes per hour
Divider Pro: pre-sorter for processor and packer lines, removes foreign material and rot, widths 1 to 3 metres
Divider Select: farm pre-sorter for harvest and store loading, up to 120 tonnes per hour
RejectSeparator: compact optical sorter that recovers usable product from reject streams
facts: Over 500 machines in more than 22 countries (potato sorter page)

contact.address: Flikweert Vision, Platte Capelledijk 1, 4306NE Nieuwerkerk, Netherlands

limitations: The website gives no explicit founding year and does not name the founders or owners.
